current_events: The Gaza Health Ministry says that over 1,000 Palestinians have been killed in Gaza Strip since the ceasefire was announced last year
Hamas reports progress in the second phase of ceasefire talks
The Israel Defense Forces says that they have killed two Hamas militants who allegedly took part in the October 7 attacks on Israel over the weekend in a airstrike in the central Gaza Strip

Iran foreign ministry spokesperson Esmail Baghaei tells Iranian state media that President Masoud Pezeshkian and U.S. president Donald Trump remotely sign the deal to end the war with Iran, extend the ceasefire by 60-days, and reopening the Strait of Hormuz. Trump reportedly signed the agreement while at the G7 Summit during a dinner with French president Emmanuel Macron
American officials from the Trump administration officially release the memorandum of understanding agreement reached with Iran
Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif and Chief of Defense Forces Field Marshal Asim Munir are expected to attend the ceremony in Switzerland on Friday and host the signing ceremony
2025–2026 Iran–United States negotiations

Ship tracking websites, including Kpler, MarineTraffic, and TankerTrackers shows that three Iranian oil tankers, including two from the National Iranian Tanker Company, have escaped the blockade that was imposed on April 13 by the United States. Additionally, the Iranian-flagged NITC vessel M/T Stream have reached the blockade line as it headed towards the Gulf of Oman
2026 United States naval blockade of Iran
Pentagon AI chief Cameron Stanley says that Elon Musk’s Grok chatbot was used to launch 2,000 missiles and munitions at Iran during Operation Epic Fury
Tropical Storm Arthur forms, becoming the first tropical cyclone of the season after creating significant rainfall across Mexico and Texas, United States
2026 Atlantic hurricane season
The names of the eight victims during the B-52 Stratofortress crash at Edwards Air Force Base in Kern County, California, United States, are identified
2026 United States Air Force Boeing B-52 crash
The European Union and G7 nations at the summit in Évian-les-Bains pledge funding for the Democratic Republic of the Congo amidst the Ebola epidemic in the country, including the Itiru province

The TASIS-aligned Peace Government officially declares a cholera outbreak in the Kordofan region, with laboratory tests in South Sudan confirming the disease, after weeks of acute watery diarrhoea cases in West Kordofan

In the U.S., the Republican-led Georgia General Assembly rejects governor Brian Kemp's attempt to redistrict Georgia's congressional districts for the 2028 United States House of Representatives elections in the state after state House speaker Jon G. Burns announced that he will not hold a vote to do so
2027–2028 United States redistricting

The Philippine Senate elects Sherwin Gatchalian as Senate president, formally removing Alan Peter Cayetano and ending a leadership dispute that began on June 3. Gatchalian receives the support of all 13 senators present during a special session
June 2026 President of the Senate of the Philippines election
The Norway palace says that Crown Princess Mette-Marit underwent a lung transplant surgery at the Oslo University Hospital
In association football, Yoane Wissa scores the DR Congo's first goal at a FIFA World Cup during a 1–1 draw against Portugal in their opening match
2026 FIFA World Cup, DR Congo at the FIFA World Cup

Sudan's women's national under-17 football team makes its first appearance on international stage in Morocco in an effort to qualify for the upcoming 2028 Summer Olympics in Los Angeles amidst the ongoing civil war in the country that erupted three years ago
